summary: Domain discovery completed read-only. Bounded contexts, aggregate boundaries, deterministic invariants, provenance requirements, transaction boundaries, and draft contract inventory were identified.
decisions: Use modular-monolith domain boundaries from target architecture.
Make QuoteRevision the central commercial snapshot aggregate.
Represent edge banding as PartEdge north/east/south/west records.
Treat PriceObservation as append-only evidence and CostSnapshot as frozen provenance.
Nesting must be placement-derived with heuristic version and deterministic seed.
Agent tools may explain and draft actions but never calculate authoritative totals.
assumptions: Money type, ID type, workflow adapter, template formula contract, and snapshot transaction boundaries require ADRs or contract decisions before implementation.
Initial nesting can use a deterministic heuristic if tests prove bounds, overlap, grain, kerf, trim, and reproducibility.

verification.command: Get-Content -Raw for required P1 documents and orchestration files
verification.evidence: Read-only discovery completed; no files edited.

blockers: Executable OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, schemas, and golden fixtures are not frozen yet.
residual_risks: ProductTemplate formula DSL/schema is not yet specified enough for safe consumers.
Calculation job and async workflow transaction boundaries need explicit idempotency and outbox rules.
Domain rules are documented but not yet mapped to executable schemas and tests.
requested_next_action: Parent should consolidate P1 handoffs, record ADRs, and freeze initial contracts before P2 fan-out.
